guidance.statement: EBITDA margin in the beauty vertical can sustainably improve going forward.
guidance.quote: I think EBITDA margin should be good. I don't want to guide towards any direction, but I think it can sustainably improve going forward.

achieved.claim: Delivered GMV growth of 28% year-on-year to INR 5,795 crores in Q3 FY26.
Achieved net revenue of INR 2,873 crores, representing 27% year-on-year growth.
Delivered highest ever EBITDA margin of 8.0% with EBITDA of INR 230 crores.
Reported PAT of INR 68 crores (2.4% net revenue), up 156% year-on-year.

pushback.concern: Whether rapid customer acquisition causes lower AOVs and dilutes quality or profitability.
Sustainability of BPC gross margin expansion and ad income seasonality impact.
Commercial construct and profitability details of the new strategic partnership with Nike.

output.tone_why: Management highlighted highest-ever EBITDA margin, strong 28% GMV growth, and broad structural momentum across verticals.
